i.norm: Tests for the NYSIIS (New York State Identification and Intelligence System) phonetic encoding algorithm, focusing on names that share a common NYSIIS code.
Asserts that each of the given names encodes to the specified NYSIIS code using the strict (default) encoder.
These phonetically related names all map to the same NYSIIS code "DAN"
